operations.name: generate
operations.description: Single-turn or multi-turn text generation via the stable Chat Completions surface (POST /v1/chat/completions), not the newer Responses API (POST /v1/responses) — a deliberate v1 stability choice (connectors-architecture.md §5.2), cheap to revisit via a version bump. KNOWN v1 LIMITATION: this connector sends the normalized max_tokens field as the request body's max_tokens. OpenAI's o-series reasoning models (o1/o3/o4-mini) reject max_tokens and require max_completion_tokens instead; this connector does not special-case model family (the normalized input carries no model-family signal to key on) — calling generate with an o-series model name surfaces the provider's own 400 as a typed ConnectorInvocationError, not a silent failure or a wrong-parameter retry.

data_flows: input.messages (role 'system' entries included verbatim as chat messages) and input.model/max_tokens/temperature are sent, as JSON, to provider.base_url (or its base_url_override_env override, when explicitly configured) over HTTPS.
No data is sent anywhere else — there is no secondary destination, logging sink, or analytics call in this connector.
The provider's full raw response is returned to the caller unmodified as output.raw; nothing is dropped, redacted, or summarized before being handed back.
